name: GitHub Actions
summary: GitHub Actions runs workflows from a repository on GitHub. Every plan includes a monthly dollar allowance for hosted runners, from $12 on Free to $300 on Enterprise Cloud, and a Linux 2-core runner costs $0.006 a minute after that. Self-hosted runners and public repositories cost nothing as of November 2026.

facts.text: The included allowance is a dollar amount, not a number of minutes: $12 on Free, $18 on Pro and Team, and $300 on Enterprise Cloud each month.
Standard GitHub-hosted runners are free in public repositories, while larger runners are billed even there.
Deployment environments can require reviewers to approve a job before it runs.
In December 2025 GitHub announced a $0.002 per minute platform charge for self-hosted runners from March 1, 2026, then postponed it to re-evaluate. No new date was given.
Workflow run logs can be viewed, searched, downloaded or deleted from the Actions tab, with GitHub CLI or through the API.

plans.name: GitHub Free
plans.notes: $12 of hosted runner usage each month, 500 MB artifact storage

plans.name: GitHub Pro
plans.notes: $18 of hosted runner usage each month, 1 GB artifact storage. The plan price is not on the Actions billing page

plans.name: GitHub Team
plans.notes: $18 of hosted runner usage each month, 2 GB artifact storage. The plan price is not on the Actions billing page

plans.name: GitHub Enterprise Cloud
plans.notes: $300 of hosted runner usage each month, 50 GB artifact storage, about 50,000 Linux minutes. The plan price is not on the Actions billing page

plans.name: Linux 2-core runner overage
plans.notes: Billed after the included allowance is used

hiddenCosts: Larger runners are billed even in public repositories.
The allowance is in dollars, so minutes on macOS, Windows or larger runners use it up faster than Linux minutes.
Self-hosted runners were free as of November 2026, but GitHub announced and then postponed a $0.002 per minute charge for them.
